healthcare.title: A call mid-treatment — without interrupting anyone
healthcare.intro: For clinics the phone is both the lifeline and the biggest distraction. Every rebooking, every appointment and every question about opening hours takes time away from the patient in front of you. The AI receptionist takes the call, finds an open slot in your calendar and confirms it while you look after the clinic.
healthcare.situation: At 08:14 a patient calls to move their appointment. Reception is already with a patient at the desk, and the call would normally interrupt both.

chat.text: Hi, I'm afraid I need to move my appointment on Thursday.
I can sort that out. I can see your appointment on Thursday at 09:00. Would Thursday 10:30 or Friday 14:00 suit you better?
Thursday 10:30 is perfect.
That's moved. You'll get a confirmation by email in a moment.

outcomes: Rebookings and cancellations are handled without interrupting reception
Rescheduling and cancelling around the clock frees up slots for other patients
Patients can call and book outside opening hours — evenings and weekends too
Everything is noted and added to the calendar, so you have the full picture afterwards

craftsman.title: The job gets booked while your hands are still full
craftsman.intro: For a tradesperson every missed call is potentially a lost job. You can't answer mid-task, and the customer simply rings the next number. The AI receptionist takes the call, gathers the address, job type and urgency, and books a site visit straight into your calendar.
craftsman.situation: At 10:47 a new customer calls about a bathroom. You're up a ladder at another job and can't answer.

chat.text: Hi, I need a new bathroom fitted. Could you come and take a look?
Of course. Could I take the address, and is it the whole bathroom or just part of it?
14 Nørregade, and it's the whole room.
Noted. I have a free visit on Friday at 08:00 — shall I put it in the calendar?

outcomes: No jobs lost because the phone wasn't answered in time
Address, job type and urgency are logged before you call back
Site visits land straight in your calendar — no double bookings
Automatic reminders to the customer the day before the visit

office.title: Room to concentrate — without leaving customers waiting
office.intro: In an office, interruptions are expensive. Every call about status, prices or meeting times pulls someone out of their work. The AI receptionist screens every inbound call, answers the routine ones itself, books meetings in the shared calendar and notes everything else with a short summary so you can call back.
office.situation: At 13:05 a customer calls to book a meeting. The team is mid-deadline, and a call would cost all of their focus.

chat.text: Hi, I'd like to book a meeting about our case.
Of course. I can see openings on Tuesday at 11:00 and Wednesday at 14:30 — which suits you best?
Wednesday at 14:30.
That's booked. You'll both get a calendar invitation right away.

outcomes: Fewer interruptions mean longer stretches of focused work
Routine questions about status, prices and opening hours are answered automatically
Meetings are booked straight into the team's shared calendar
Anything the AI can't resolve is put through or saved with a summary in the dashboard

ecommerce.title: The question gets answered before the cart is abandoned
ecommerce.intro: In a webshop a large share of traffic arrives outside opening hours, and one unanswered question about delivery, sizing or returns quickly becomes an abandoned cart. The AI widget answers on your site instantly — around the clock — and carries the customer all the way to a completed order.
ecommerce.situation: At 21:38 a customer has the item in their cart but is unsure about delivery and returns. Support doesn't open until tomorrow.

chat.text: When would I get it if I order now?
Order before 22:00 and we ship tomorrow — you'd typically have it in 1-2 working days.
And if it doesn't fit?
You have 30 days to return it, and the return label is in your order confirmation.

outcomes: Product, delivery and returns questions answered instantly — evenings included
Fewer abandoned carts, because the doubt is cleared up on the spot
Complex cases are handed to your team with the full conversation as context
No waiting and no queue — however many people ask at once

salon.title: The appointment gets booked while you hold the scissors
salon.intro: In a salon the phone always rings at the wrong moment: mid-cut, mid-colour or in the middle of a manicure. The AI receptionist takes the call, finds a free slot in your calendar and books it, so the client doesn't call the next salon instead.
salon.situation: At 11:20 a client calls to book a cut and colour. You're in the middle of a colour treatment and can't answer.

chat.text: Hi, I'd like an appointment for a cut and colour next week.
I can help with that. I have Tuesday at 10:00 or Thursday at 14:30. Which suits you best?
Thursday at 14:30.
You're booked for a cut and colour on Thursday at 14:30. You'll get a confirmation by email in a moment.

outcomes: No client calls elsewhere because you were busy with someone in the chair
Cancellations and changes are handled straight away, so the slot can go to someone else
Clients can move or cancel themselves, so free slots can be rebooked
Clients can also book through the chat on your website in the evening
